text:
Phase 1 (`requirements_analysis`) is complete. The requirements specification has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-120000-feature-new-drawing-pages/requirements.md` with:

- **In scope (1–9)** and **Out of scope (1–6)** aligned with the Gate 0 approved `intent_brief.md`.
- **Functional requirements (`FR-1` to `FR-15`)** grouped by module (`packages/element`, `packages/excalidraw` across state, tab bar UI, history, export/serialization, restore, search, and i18n, and `excalidraw-app` across collaboration and local storage), written to hold under either page-membership representation.
- **Non-functional requirements (`NFR-1` to `NFR-7`)** covering `.excalidraw` backward compatibility, strict package boundaries (`packages/*` never importing `excalidraw-app`), immutable element mutations via `newElementWith`/`mutateElement`, `AppState` wiring across type/defaults/storage table/`restoreAppState`, `AGENTS.md` rules (`app.ownerDocument`/`ownerWindow`, `Merge<>`), `locales/en.json`-only i18n, and verification commands.
- **PII inventory** and **Role matrix** (Local User in edit/view modes and Collaborator).
- **Acceptance criteria (`AC-1` to `AC-9`)** with full traceability to all `FR-*` and `NFR-*` items.
- **Open questions for HITL / Architect**, deferring the page-membership representation (`pageId` on elements vs. per-page element arrays/scenes) to the Phase 2 ADR.
